dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, linear 2D narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with low-intensity blue-grey shading along the lateral flanks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct, dark longitudinal linear feature located on the upper dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear topological depression creating a high-contrast shadow along the upper central-right axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant longitudinal dark linear mark, potentially a healed scar or deep tissue indentation, on the cranial-dorsal surface.
